events.name: Glassdoor
events.note: Employer review and job site bought by Recruit Holdings, the owner of Indeed, for US$1.2 billion.

source.title: Glassdoor - Wikipedia
source.quote: In 2018, the company was acquired by the Japanese company Recruit Holdings (owner of Indeed) for US$1.2 billion.

events.name: Indeed
events.note: Job search site acquired by Japan-based Recruit Co. Ltd. and run as an independent operating unit.

source.title: Indeed - Wikipedia
source.quote: On October 1, 2012, Indeed was acquired by Japan-based Recruit Co. Ltd., becoming an independent operating unit.

events.name: Monster
events.note: Job board merged with CareerBuilder in 2024, with Apollo-managed funds becoming majority owner; Randstad had bought Monster.com in 2016.

source.title: Randstad (company) - Wikipedia
source.quote: In September 2024, Monster.com merged with CareerBuilder.

events.name: CareerBuilder
events.note: Job board bought by private-equity firm Apollo Global Management, later merged with Monster.com in 2024.

source.title: CareerBuilder - Wikipedia
source.quote: In June 2017, CareerBuilder was purchased by the private-equity firm Apollo Global Management

events.name: Taleo
events.note: Recruiting and talent software vendor acquired by Oracle Corporation for $1.9 billion.

source.title: Taleo - Wikipedia
source.quote: On February 9, 2012, Oracle Corporation acquired Taleo Corporation for $1.9 billion.

events.name: SuccessFactors
events.note: HR and recruiting software vendor acquired by SAP; the acquisition was completed in February 2012.

source.title: SuccessFactors - Wikipedia
source.quote: The acquisition was completed on February 16, 2012.

events.name: Jobvite
events.note: Applicant tracking vendor purchased by K1 Investment Management and merged with JazzHR and NXTThing RPO.

source.title: Jobvite - Wikipedia
source.quote: In April 2021, K1 Investment Management purchased and merged Jobvite with JazzHR and NXTThing RPO.

events.name: Hired
events.note: Tech recruitment marketplace acquired by Vettery, which was part of the Adecco Group.

source.title: Hired (company) - Wikipedia
source.quote: In November 2020, Vettery acquired the technology recruitment platform Hired.

events.name: Vettery
events.note: Recruitment marketplace startup acquired by the Adecco Group for $100 million USD.

source.title: Adecco - Wikipedia
source.quote: The Adecco Group acquired Vettery, a recruitment marketplace startup, for $100 million USD in February 2018.

events.name: SimplyHired
events.note: Job search site purchased by Recruit Holdings, a competitor of Indeed in the same group.

source.title: SimplyHired - Wikipedia
source.quote: In 2016, Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd. purchased Simply Hired.

events.name: Workopolis
events.note: Canadian job board purchased by Recruit Holdings, owner of Indeed. The Wikipedia lead gives June 2018 for the same deal, so the month is unresolved.

source.title: Workopolis - Wikipedia
source.quote: Recruit Holdings, owners of Indeed purchased Workopolis in April 2018.

events.name: OCC Mundial
events.note: Mexican job board sold by SEEK to Barcelona-based Red Arbor, which operates job boards in the region.

source.title: Seek (company) - Wikipedia
source.quote: SEEK sold its holdings in the Latin American job-boards OCC (Mexico) and Catho (Brazil)

events.name: Catho
events.note: Brazilian job board sold by SEEK to Barcelona-based Red Arbor, which operates job boards in the region.

source.title: Seek (company) - Wikipedia
source.quote: SEEK sold its holdings in the Latin American job-boards OCC (Mexico) and Catho (Brazil)

events.name: Identified
events.note: Recruiting startup acquired by Workday along with its artificial intelligence technology.

source.title: Workday, Inc. - Wikipedia
source.quote: Workday acquired the startup Identified and its artificial intelligence

events.name: 7S Group
events.note: German HR services firm acquired by ManpowerGroup for $140.4 million.

source.title: ManpowerGroup - Wikipedia
source.quote: On September 3, 2015, ManpowerGroup acquired 7S Group GmbH, a German HR services firm, for $140.4 million.

events.name: Programmed Maintenance
events.note: Australian labour hire company acquired by Persol for $778M.

source.title: Persol Holdings - Wikipedia
source.quote: In October 2017, it acquired the Australian labour hire company Programmed Maintenance for $778M.
